portInfo.description: The strait gives the city its maritime identity, while the cathedral square, Annunziata dei Catalani and the regional museum provide a day that need not leave Messina. Taormina is a possible longer road excursion, not the same place as the Messina waterfront. Do not confuse this catalog entry with Taormina/Giardini Naxos.

gettingThere.distanceToCity: Budget 25 minutes from the assigned berth through its permitted exit to Piazza Duomo, with 30 minutes for the return/security. An outer or temporarily restricted face can need a shuttle, so obtain the gate before setting off. For the regional museum or Taormina, use a prearranged road pickup outside the controlled port; no fare or departure frequency was verified.
gettingThere.publicTransport: Confirm local transport options with the ship on your call date.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Cathedral and Piazza Duomo — Piazza Duomo, Messina. The civic/religious centre is the core short-call stop. Allow 50 minutes; official source.

Astronomical clock tower — Cathedral campanile, Piazza Duomo, Messina. A distinct clock/bell-tower sight; do not promise an interior climb or performance time without checking. Allow 30 minutes; official source.
Orion Fountain — Piazza Duomo, Messina. Study it together with the square rather than driving to another town. Allow 20 minutes; official source.
Santissima Annunziata dei Catalani — Annunziata dei Catalani church, central Messina. A different architectural layer from the cathedral; worship can limit entry. Allow 30 minutes; official source.

Regional Museum of Messina — Maria Accascina Regional Museum, Messina; use its municipal map link. Plan a separate local transfer and check current ticket/opening rules. Allow 100 minutes; official source.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: A clock-tower ambition must fit the return plan. Check the actual viewing/performance arrangements rather than delaying departure for an unsourced “daily show” promise.
